steps.title: Where sessions live today
steps.text: Every request passes through `auth middleware`, which looks up the `sid` cookie in the session store. Before this commit a session never expired; it stayed valid until logout.
steps.narration: Requests are authenticated by a store lookup, and sessions had no expiry.

steps.title: Sessions now carry an expiry
steps.text: `create_session` stores a `SessionRecord` with `expires_at` instead of a bare user id. `SESSION_TTL` defaults to 8 hours and reads from the `AUTH_SESSION_TTL` environment variable.
steps.narration: Each stored session now records when it stops being valid.

visual.hunk:
@@ -1,6 +1,17 @@
 import secrets
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+
+SESSION_TTL = timedelta(seconds=int(os.environ.get("AUTH_SESSION_TTL", 28800)))
+
+@dataclass
+class SessionRecord:
+    user_id: int
+    expires_at: datetime
 
 def create_session(user):
     token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
-    store[token] = user.id
+    expires = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + SESSION_TTL
+    store[token] = SessionRecord(user.id, expires)
     return token

steps.title: Lookups reject expired sessions
steps.text: `get_session` compares `expires_at` with the current UTC time. An expired record is deleted on read and the caller gets `None`, the same result as an unknown token.
steps.narration: Reading an expired session deletes it and behaves like a missing session.

visual.hunk:
@@ -17,2 +28,8 @@ def create_session(user):
 def get_session(token):
-    return store.get(token)
+    record = store.get(token)
+    if record is None:
+        return None
+    if record.expires_at <= datetime.now(timezone.utc):
+        del store[token]
+        return None
+    return record

steps.title: Middleware returns 401 on expiry
steps.text: The middleware now reads `record.user_id` instead of the raw value. When `get_session` returns `None` it clears the `sid` cookie so the browser stops sending a dead token.
steps.narration: Expired sessions produce a 401 and the stale cookie is removed.

visual.hunk:
@@ -9,4 +9,7 @@ async def auth_middleware(request, call_next):
     token = request.cookies.get("sid")
-    user_id = get_session(token)
-    if user_id is None:
-        return JSONResponse({"error": "unauthorized"}, status_code=401)
+    record = get_session(token)
+    if record is None:
+        response = JSONResponse({"error": "unauthorized"}, status_code=401)
+        response.delete_cookie("sid")
+        return response
+    request.state.user_id = record.user_id

steps.title: A sweeper removes abandoned sessions
steps.text: Sessions that are never read again would stay in memory forever. `sweep_expired` runs every 5 minutes from the existing scheduler and deletes all records past `expires_at`.
steps.narration: A periodic job cleans up sessions nobody reads anymore.

steps.title: Tests use a frozen clock
steps.text: The new tests patch `datetime.now` to move past the TTL instead of sleeping. They cover expiry on read, the cookie removal, and the sweeper.
steps.narration: Tests freeze time to check expiry without waiting.

visual.code:
def test_expired_session_is_rejected(frozen_clock):
    token = create_session(User(id=7))
    frozen_clock.advance(SESSION_TTL + timedelta(seconds=1))
    assert get_session(token) is None
    assert token not in store
